item.title: Macron and Starmer hold international summit on reopening the Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: The leaders of France and the U.K. are holding an international summit to push forward efforts to reopen the Strait of Hormuz, a vital oil route affected by the U.S.-Israeli war with Iran

item.title: Cuba's president says island does not wish for US aggression but ready to fight if needed
item.summary: Cuban President Miguel Díaz-Canel says that while Cuba does not want military aggression from the United States, his country is prepared to fight should it happen

item.title: What to know about Pakistan’s army chief and his role as mediator between Iran and the US
item.summary: Field Marshal Asim Munir, Pakistan's army chief, is playing a crucial role in mediating between Iran and the U.S. A recent video shows him in Tehran, highlighting his involvement in easing tensions

item.title: Canada Post taking steps to stop home mail delivery
item.summary: The government-owned corporation that delivers mail in Canada is taking steps to stop home delivery

item.title: Australia's most decorated veteran granted bail on war crimes charges related to Afghan deaths
item.summary: Australia’s most decorated living veteran has been granted bail 10 days after he was charged with committing war crimes in Afghanistan

item.title: Archbishop of Canterbury expresses solidarity with Pope Leo XIV in calling for peace
item.summary: The Archbishop of Canterbury on Thursday expressed solidarity with Pope Leo XIV in calling for peace in the Middle East

item.title: Myanmar frees more than 4,500 prisoners in traditional new year amnesty
item.summary: More than 4,500 prisoners in Myanmar have been granted amnesty and others have had their sentences reduced under a pardon order by President Min Aung Hlaing to mark the traditional new year

item.title: Airline adding bunk beds for economy travelers but bans snacks, smells and cuddling
item.summary: Air New Zealand will soon add triple-tier bunk beds for economy travelers to have a chance to sleep on long-haul flights

item.title: South Korean pianist recreates himself after having a stroke
item.summary: In 2012, South Korean pianist Lee Hun suffered a major stroke that left him with a right-sided paralysis

item.title: Minibus taxi catches fire in Zimbabwe, killing several people
item.summary: Police in Zimbabwe say that several people were killed when a minibus taxi they were traveling in caught fire
